info.title: Sanjivani AI Health Risk Screening Platform
info.description: Production-grade, explainable, and multilingual AI health risk screening platform for India. Strictly provides screening support and early cardiometabolic risk stratification—never definitive medical diagnosis. Complies with India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023.

post.description:
Execute end-to-end AI health risk screening.

Integrates:
- Multi-condition risk classifiers with probability calibration and recall-prioritized thresholds
- Trajectory regression forecaster with Conformal Prediction intervals
- Patient phenotyping, auto-labeled clustering & anomaly detection
- Local SHAP top 5 feature attributions
- Plain-language multilingual explanations in English, Hindi, and Punjabi (Class 8 level)
- Emergency red-flag triage
- Statutory non-diagnostic clinical disclaimer.

get.description: Retrieve longitudinal cardiometabolic trajectory and screening history.

schema.title: Response Get Patient Screening History Api V1 History  Patient Id  Get

post.description:
Grounded RAG conversational assistant adhering to WHO, ICMR, and ADA guidelines.

Enforces:
- Rejection of prescription requests and medical diagnosis
- Emergency red-flag symptom triage
- Accredited clinical citation tracking
- Statutory non-diagnostic clinical disclaimer.

Exercise 'Right to Erasure' under Section 12 of India DPDP Act 2023.

Permanently purges patient PII, screenings, and consent records.
